subject.title: [Bug]: publishable plugin runtime builds cannot emit native CJS entrypoints

question: Should maintainers accept `openclaw.build.runtimeFormat: "cjs"` as the way official plugin packages opt into native CJS runtime outputs for msteams?
rationale: The implementation path changes official plugin package build metadata and installed-package sidecar format, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive maintainer territory.

options.title: Review the linked PR for merge
options.body: Keep this issue open and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102366 as the candidate fix if it preserves default ESM builds and proves msteams `.cjs` outputs.

options.title: Reject the CJS build surface
options.body: Close or revise the linked PR if maintainers decide publishable plugin packages should stay ESM-only or solve startup cost through a different packaging design.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR for merge
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102366 as the candidate fix if it preserves default ESM builds and proves msteams `.cjs` outputs.
